awards.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: premium square category icon for a cinema quiz website, matching a cohesive set of polished 3D collectible objects. Create one production-ready icon, NOT a page or mockup.
Subject: a distinguished cinema award trophy, a substantial five-point gold star sculpted atop a short ivory-and-deep-teal enamel pedestal. Two beautifully modeled gold laurel branches rise around the star, framing it as a film festival prize. A short elegant curved strip of teal film with gold perforated edges is integrated around the base. One coherent, compact sculptural object with a clear silhouette.
Style: high-end photorealistic 3D studio render, tactile ivory porcelain, richly brushed and polished warm gold, deep teal lacquer, finely crafted beveled edges, realistic metal grain and specular highlights. Sophisticated, substantial, highly detailed, matching luxurious ivory and gold vintage film projectors and teal-and-gold cinema emblems.
Composition: entire object centered on a square canvas, frontal three-quarter view, approximately 85 percent of canvas height, balanced broad silhouette, generous transparent margin on every edge. Readable as an award even at 40 pixels; polished sculptural quality at 160 pixels.
Lighting: soft warm studio key from upper left, subtle rim light and realistic self-shading; no ground plane, no backdrop, no cast shadow outside the object.
Constraints: real transparent RGBA background with clean alpha edges, no opaque rectangular background, no text, letters, logos, watermark, caption or border. No stopwatch, no trophy cup, no human statuette, no real award logo. One icon only.

actors.prompt:

A small elegant ivory-and-gold film clapperboard rests at their shared lower edge, clearly connecting the portraits to cinema, with a few bold diagonal gold stripes and no writing.

Sophisticated, substantial, highly detailed, matching luxurious ivory and gold vintage film projectors and teal-and-gold cinema emblems. Lighting: soft warm studio key from upper left, subtle rim light and realistic self-shading; no ground plane, no backdrop, no cast shadow outside the object.
Constraints: real transparent RGBA background with clean alpha edges, no opaque rectangular background, no text, letters, logos, watermark, caption or border. No recognizable celebrity likeness, no theatrical masks, no laurel wreath, trophy or star award. One icon only.
